The area carrying the inscription "DE" is filled orange.

B.text: If the map fill is encoded by the adjacent color legend, then lighter yellow corresponds to higher plotted values because the legend places "High" and "100" at its light-yellow top and "Low" and "0" at its dark-red bottom; among compared state fills, the lighter fill has the higher plotted value.
B.conditions: Applies to states with visible labeled fills on this map and assumes the legend governs those fills.

O.content: The title visibly reads "Incidence of Condition A in US States."

O.location: map legend and the labeled NH, DE, and FL areas
O.content: The legend runs from light-yellow "High"/"100" to dark-red "Low"/"0"; NH is pale yellow, DE is orange, and FL is dark burgundy.

B.text: If the dashboard named by the task is intended as the evidence source for the requested prevalence-priority route despite the chart title using "Incidence," then the state with the highest plotted map value among the listed options is the state to route for highest-prevalence follow-up.
B.conditions: Requires treating the chart's plotted measure as applicable to the task's prevalence criterion; this is not explicitly established because the visible title says "Incidence of Condition A in US States."
